ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (near-black) background estimated at 85% coverage, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and lines providing approximately 15% coverage.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A continuous low-intensity dark field across both lobes, overlaid with a decentralized mapping of high-intensity white linear streaks (rake marks) and localized circular white-on-black clusters (rosettes) distributed across the central and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees, penetrating deeply towards the caudal peduncle area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire visible margin; characterized by jagged, irregular peak-to-valley pixel transitions particularly pronounced on the lateral portions of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a general concave sweep from the median notch towards the distal tips, disrupted by significant irregular topographic deviations and structural indentations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct clusters of circular/annular high-contrast pixels are detected; notably a cluster of approximately six rosettes on the right lobe and scattered individual rosettes on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, multi-directional network of high-intensity linear pixel streaks (scars) visible across the entirety of both lobes, including several long diagonal marks exceeding 20% of the total lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of high-relief, irregular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) attached to the extreme distal tips and various points along the leading edge; significant jagged structural irregularity on the outer-right lobe margin suggestive of tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity 'parallel' rake mark pattern located in the lower-left quadrant of the visible fluke surface.
